svg.title: SAGE routing pipeline and evidence loop
svg.desc: Four-stage routing pipeline: hard feasibility gate, tri-mode candidate generation, requirement assignment with DAG scheduling, and constrained utility ranking, followed by an execution plan and an evidence-driven posterior update loop.

svg.text: SAGE does not transmit tasks, authenticate endpoints, or verify signatures. Discovery, transport, credentials, and artifact handling remain with the registry and the A2A client.
